title: Interim Deposit True-Up on Reduced Group Room Blocks
content:
How the applicable interim percentage of a Group Room Blocks interim deposit, that is, the interim percentage that applies to the block, turns into the amount follows the block's reductions and how the signing deposit was paid:

1. When the block ledger carries **reduction entries** and the **signing deposit entry is dated no more than the block type's signing-deposit period** of calendar days after the proposal date, the interim deposit is the applicable interim percentage plus the block type's signing deposit percentage, applied to the anticipated room revenue (the contracted room nights times the group rate), less all the deposits received on the block ledger, so that the part of the signing deposit above the signing percentage of the reduced revenue is credited.
2. When the block ledger carries **reduction entries** and the signing deposit entry is **dated later than that, or there is no signing deposit entry**, the interim deposit is the applicable interim percentage applied to the room nights contracted at signing, which are the room nights of the block's allocation entry, times the group rate.
3. When the block ledger carries **no reduction entry**, the interim deposit is the applicable interim percentage applied to the anticipated room revenue.

### Block-type figures read by the rule

| Block type | Signing deposit percentage | Signing-deposit period (calendar days after the proposal) |
|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 15 | 7 |
| Wedding Room Block | 10 | 7 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 10 | 3 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 0 | 0 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 0 | 0 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 0 | 0 |

### Worked true-up (hypothetical Social Event Room Block; applicable interim percentage assumed at 25)

Allocation entry 200 room nights at 150.00 USD; a signing deposit of 4,500.00 USD received 5 days after the proposal; reduction entries of 20 room nights, leaving 180 contracted room nights and an anticipated room revenue of 27,000.00 USD.

| Case | Interim deposit |
|---|---|
| Branch 1 (reductions, signing deposit on time): 40 percent of 27,000.00 is 10,800.00, less 4,500.00 received | 6,300.00 USD |
| Branch 2 (same block, signing deposit received 9 days after the proposal): 25 percent of 200 times 150.00 | 7,500.00 USD |
| Branch 3 (no reduction entry, 200 contracted room nights): 25 percent of 30,000.00 | 7,500.00 USD |

In branch 1 the signing percentage of the reduced revenue is 4,050.00 USD; the 450.00 USD paid above it is the part credited, and 25 percent of 27,000.00 less 450.00 gives the same 6,300.00 USD.
